data.question: Why was FCRM-2026-0151 routed to committee instead of closed by the analyst? (chain: 67 records, head 97359b50)

sentences.text: The first score put the case in Band 2 with delegated close, which would have left it with the analyst.

quotes: 0.3 below the Band 3 edge · acknowledgement required
sentences.text: That first score was flagged as close to the next band, and the analyst had to acknowledge the flag.
Next, Rahul Iyer overrode the CTL-T01 rating; the record says a reason was recorded but the summary does not give its text.
The score was then recomputed as Composite 10.4 in Band 3, and the record states the route as committee.
Under routing v4 rule R2, Band 3 or 4 goes to the Risk Committee instead of analyst close. Record 50 states the Band 3 outcome but does not name the rule itself.

quotes: Band change and boundary flag acknowledged by analyst
sentences.text: The analyst acknowledged the band change and the boundary flag.
The pack was then released to the committee members.

data.question: What was overridden on FCRM-2026-0151, and why? (chain: 67 records, head 97359b50)

sentences.text: The control rating for CTL-T01 was overridden by Rahul Iyer, from 7.6 to 4.5.

The records do not state why. Record 49 says only that a reason was recorded, and the text of that reason is not in the record, so I cannot give it. I read all 67 records in compact form and the full payloads of records 49 and 50.
After the override, the composite score was recomputed as 10.4, Band 3, with the route set to committee.
Before the override, the composite score was 9.8, Band 2, with a delegated close.

sentences.text: The analyst then acknowledged the band change and the boundary flag.

data.question: How did the committee reach its outcome on FCRM-2026-0151? (chain: 67 records, head 97359b50)

sentences.text: The first computed score put the case in Band 2 with a delegated close.
Rahul Iyer then overrode the rating on control CTL-T01 from 7.6 to 4.5, and the record states a reason was recorded.
The recomputed score was 10.4 in Band 3, and the record routes the case to the committee.

quotes: Band change and boundary flag acknowledged by analyst
sentences.text: The analyst acknowledged the band change and the boundary flag.

quotes: Released to 3 committee members · votes hidden until all cast
sentences.text: The pack was released to 3 committee members, with votes hidden until all were cast.

quotes: attached as pack addendum · numbers unchanged
sentences.text: Ana Mendes put a question to the analyst, and Rahul Iyer's answer was attached as a pack addendum with the numbers unchanged.
All three votes were cast while hidden.
The tally, done by code, was approve with conditions 2 and defer 1.
The outcome was set as approved with conditions, with 3 conditions activated.
